biggest_catch: Official terms promise a straight price match only — no 10% beat, no matching of shipping/service costs, and no matching during Black Friday or special promotions.
catches: Straight price match only; shipping, delivery, and installation/service costs are excluded.
Third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon are excluded (must be sold directly by the competing retailer).
No price matching during Black Friday or other special promotions.
Item must be identical in brand, model number, specifications, color, finish, and size — small differences disqualify.
Competitor must be able to ship the item to your location.

c1.evidence: Direct official Home Depot 'Price Match Guarantee & Price Inquiries' page: item must be identical (brand, model number, specifications, color, finish, size); third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon excluded; no matching during Black Friday/special promotions; shipping/service costs not matched; competitor must be able to ship to customer location.

c2.evidence: Concrete: show the competitor's lower in-stock price (ad, printout, website link, photo) at the register; for homedepot.com purchases, contact Live Chat or 1-800-628-0525 before buying.

c4.evidence: Concrete: typical example $20-$150 per big-ticket item (example-based, marked).

eligibility: Anyone; identical new item at a current lower price from a qualifying competitor
maximize: Before buying any big-ticket tool, appliance, or renovation item at Home Depot, check the other store's price — Home Depot matches qualifying competitors at purchase, so the research costs one search. Bring a screenshot or link showing the identical in-stock item at the lower price to the register, or use Live Chat for online orders. Focus on shared national brands (Samsung, Bosch, DeWalt, Milwaukee) where matches actually exist; don't try matching Home Depot's exclusive brands (Ryobi, Behr) against retailers that don't carry them. Check both stores' coupons first — sometimes a coupon beats any price gap.
notes: Savings, not income: payout fields = price difference on planned spend (example-based, flagged). Official terms page is homedepot.com/c/PM_New_Lower_Price, current as checked 2026-09-23.
payout_quote: If the competitor's item has a different finish or model number, it will not qualify for price matching at Home Depot. ... Third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon are excluded. Home Depot does not price match during Black Friday or other special promotions. ... Our price match policy applies only to the cost of the product itself [not shipping, delivery, or installation services].

repeatable.cadence: Repeatable on every qualifying purchase — check for a lower price before you buy.

s1.note: Anyone with proof of the lower identical-item price.

s3.note: Match applied at register or via Live Chat at purchase.

s6.note: 4 steps: compare, prove, request, pay matched price.

steps: Compare Home Depot's price against a qualifying competitor on the identical item
Capture proof: competitor's ad, printout, website link, or photo showing the current lower price
In-store: show it at the register for validation; online: contact Live Chat or 1-800-628-0525 before purchase
Home Depot validates the item is identical and the competitor can ship it to you
who_pays: Nobody pays you — Home Depot sells you the item at the competitor's lower price. It's savings, not income.
who_qualifies: Anyone buying an identical new item with a current lower price at a qualifying competitor.
work_available: Home Depot's price-match policy is active — straight price match only.
what_gets_accepted: The item must be identical (brand, model number, specs, color, finish, size) and the competitor must sell it directly — third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon are excluded. Shipping, delivery, and installation costs are excluded, and no matches during Black Friday or special promotions.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fee. Unpaid time goes to finding the lower price and showing proof at the register or via Live Chat.
when_cash_arrives: No cash arrives — the match is applied at the register or via Live Chat at the time of purchase.
